bugs.label: A function returns the wrong number
bugs.result: An answer-key test prints a different number than its saved answer. The test fails before the change is committed.

bugs.label: One request reads data from another
bugs.result: An attack program stores data in one request and tries to read it in the next. The attack test fails if it finds anything.

bugs.label: A strange HTTP header crashes the server
bugs.result: Every night, fuzzing sends random headers to the code that reads requests. When one causes a crash, the fuzzer saves it so we can fix it.

bugs.label: Memory is used after it was freed
bugs.result: Miri and AddressSanitizer check each memory access. They report the error even when the program printed the right answer.

bugs.label: A bug no test found uses too much memory
bugs.result: Each request has a memory limit. The request stops when it goes over. The server and every other request keep running.
